notes: This is an in-process integration test: MSC 1 boots a real RemoteAPIServer on a real loopback TCP socket and drives it with actual HTTP requests, not a pure function call. 'tokenMap' is the fixed token/role/permission table every test in this source file shares (RemoteAPIIntegrationTestCase.tokenMap); 'token' fields in requests reference it by key, except literal invalid tokens used to test auth failure. Admin spot-check across every route the other roles were gated on. getFileRead (no ?path query) returns 400 missing_path — proves the request was routed past the auth layer, not blocked by it, distinct from a 401/403. postUsers reaches the inert stub provider (which in practice yields 422 not_available), but MSC 1's own test only asserts it's neither 401 nor 403 — expected mirrors that inexact assertion rather than pinning a specific code MSC 1 itself didn't pin.
